derivation: or חֵלֶץ; from H2502 (חָלַץ); perhaps, strength;
def: Chelets, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
